Uniform square cells; strictly center each creature in its cell with at least 12% transparent padding on EVERY side. No overlap across cell boundaries. No text, labels, arrows, captions, shadows or checkerboard. Genuine alpha transparency. Crisp detailed retro RPG pixel-art with dark contour, warm highlights, cute expressive large eyes, full body and all limbs visible, friendly for a child. Slight three-quarter front pose looking left. 5. Base Rootter: output Brookroot then Deltotter. Evolution details 根须臂与小木坝背甲 → 分流木盾与宽桨尾.
6. Base Petalark: output Bloomlark then Floraplume. Evolution details 更长的两层花瓣翼 → 多层花羽冠与飘带尾.
7. Base Honeyhex: output Combkeeper then Hexahive. Evolution details 蜂房肩甲与双层蜂翼 → 六瓣蜂晶冠与蜂巢腹甲.
8. Base Twiggle: output Branchamble then Boughbinder. Evolution details 原枝条尾分叉、手臂枝甲 → 枝冠与藤结背甲.
9. Base Sprigsnail: output Spiralsprig then Springhelix. Evolution details 双层螺壳与叶檐 → 泉眼壳冠与多层清水螺纹.
10. Base Seedillo: output Podrillo then Germiguard. Evolution details 籽甲间长芽、尾部加护片 → 开瓣种荚盾与根足.
